premises.text: A store-agnostic shopping rewards app lets consumers earn rewards across over one million U.S. stores with an iPhone
premises.evidence_span: the first shopping rewards application that is store agnostic

premises.text: Advertisers can reach targeted consumers in any store while the shopper is in the aisle with the product in hand
premises.evidence_span: While that consumer is in the aisle and has their product in hand, they can deliver that marketing message

premises.text: Scanning a product UPC earns points and opens an HTML5 product interaction page for advertiser messages
premises.evidence_span: put it over the UPC code, and it's that simple. They earn points

premises.text: Consumers redeem points for prizes through rewards partnerships delivered on the phone
premises.evidence_span: We have over 40 partnerships in the rewards area that the user can redeem for

premises.text: Scanning featured products earns coins that can be played in games for additional points
premises.evidence_span: Every time a user scans a featured product, they earn a coin

value.text: Advertisers drive in-store discovery and interaction while consumers get extra rewards value
value.evidence_span: allows advertisers to drive discovery and interaction in-store while providing a fun and rewarding opportunity for consumers

causal_links.evidence_span: This is the opportunity for the advertiser to reach out to the consumer with any sort of message
providing a fun and rewarding opportunity for consumers to get just a little bit of extra value
allows advertisers to drive discovery and interaction in-store

notes: Founder bio and exit excluded per 4.2. Launch-partner names treated as traction. Product-interaction delivery modes folded into P3 per v1.3.2 clarification 5.
